answer: Locks are recorded in vault, expire in island, and plume lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 99 aliases hence needs 19 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3646 identities would post 2002 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
